related_questions.snippet: Protein subunit vaccines (Novavax) Protein subunit vaccines contain pieces (proteins) of the virus that causes COVID-19. These virus pieces are the spike protein. related_questions.question: What is the N protein in the coronavirus?
related_questions.snippet: The nucleocapsid (N) protein is a protein that packages the positive-sense RNA genome of coronaviruses to form ribonucleoprotein structures enclosed within the viral capsid. The N protein is the most highly expressed of the four major coronavirus structural proteins.
